title: Reduce prepared P104 joint repair from 3N to 2N native calls
body:
This refines the explicitly prepared physical cut in [PR #3978](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3978). Complete the persistent Y bank into the common full chart once, execute all three scalar layers there, and restore its terminal chart once. The new word has **21632 positive rank-one native children versus 32448**, with **zero private copies or temporary arrays**. It implements the same ordered physical operator, original input tags and arbitrary dirty-helper returns.

The saving is in native child count and private storage. Both routes use 1049152 unit array additions; the new route adds 21632 restoring doubles. Scalar work, basis-permutation passes and inverse-translation passes remain explicit in the primitive invoice. This is not a total-runtime or optimality claim.

### Result and limits

For `T=diag(C_Uij)`, `K=T^-1`, and `C=U(A_r-I) S(I) U(A_c-I)`, the matched physical correction is `diag(I,K) C diag(I,T)`. Its chronological implementation uses one in-place T boundary, the complete scalar C word in a common F chart, then one in-place K boundary. Every rank-one recipe retains one general-f native child; the finite f=1 phase checks are not an exponential scalar implementation.

This is a new implementation of the **same declared prepared cut**. An actual chronological P104 producer, opposite native orientation and global interstage alignment remain unproved. The inherited named complete lower bill improves from 2998528 to 2987712, still exceeding capacity 2965248 by **22464**. Dependent global construction stops at that failed gate. No selected frontier, supplier admission or kappa changes.

### Verification

Exact published head: `2f7847202b324892a70a2207835224b5d04f5aec`; base `20ecf2891d80b5acf18d980b2164fb44ea7faa90`.

- Exact ordered noncommutative operator and original-input-tag checks; 208 local donor columns; canonical 104 physical labels and 10816 distinct tensor lines; 876096 binary-basis recipe checks.
- Separate 32-column Gaussian physical calculation, eight arbitrary dirty columns, literal persistent-donor rescaling, 56 finite native columns and physical/order/restoration/phase fault controls.
- Seven actual CLI mutations, each preceded by successful private-fixture validation, in both normal Python and `-O`: 28 subprocess runs. Covers typed receipt, duplicate JSON, corrupted/missing canonical sources and predecessor-export corruption.
- Repository package preflight, committed-byte/source-history checks, and official export inventory validation. All three declared commands pass from the complete read-only, Git-free export on CPython 3.12.3; all 17 files retain bytes and modes. Archive SHA256 2e201fccbaea703ea5decc60862f8989b4e6fc7863a8d4abf2d51d4298624908.

Only `research/p104-full-chart-joint/` is added. Python 3.12, standard library only. Frozen [PR #3978](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3978) proof/result are copied unchanged with exact upstream head, Git blob and SHA-256 provenance; five canonical executable inputs retain their source pins.

### Selection and credit

User-assigned changed scope under revision 6 `p104-side-correction`. Canonical main and a 702-open-PR cache including drafts were refreshed this round; the repository overlap helper and a fresh latest-updated slice were checked. Discussion/closed-diff coverage is bounded. Claim: https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3954#issuecomment-6263112891 . Parallel raw-full caller, tensor-code and source-tag studies remain separate.

Chris R / Clear1nsight owns [PR #3978](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3978)'s original compensator and copied route, following [PR #3954](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3954), [PR #3940](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3940), [PR #3882](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3882) and [PR #3943](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3943). Credit Rohan Arun/[PR #1972](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1972), Chafik Boukhalfa/[PR #1991](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1991), Adam Gall/[PR #1940](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1940), 1337isnot1337/[PR #3894](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3894), ToikY/[PR #3956](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3956)/[PR #3966](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3966)/[PR #3996](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3996) and the distinct [PR #3961](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3961)/[PR #3962](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3962)/[PR #3965](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3965) boundary, coverage and copy audits. Retain Josie Elliston, Sagar Thakrar, Douglas Colkitt, Dominik Scholz and canonical E8/native/Clifford/compiler/caller source lineage. Prepared with substantial OpenAI Codex multi-agent assistance. Apache-2.0.

The next constructive obligation is a named physical producer/consumer boundary that absorbs a conversion while preserving original source identity, arbitrary dirty returns and a complete cost gate; a common chart alone does not erase the source tags.

Reproduce: `python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-full-chart-joint`. [Hosted CI](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/39225481866) passes at the exact published head: planning, focused replay, all 28 CLI controls and committed-input preservation succeed on CPython 3.12.15.
